latestVersion.changelog: Runs the Web Search Plus 5.0.1 engine: routing by query type (Brave, Exa for docs/academic, Serper for security/shopping), faster fallback, per-URL extraction and all 5.0.1 fixes. Old flags and env vars keep working; breaking changes in CHANGELOG.md.

raw_record.summary: Search the web and extract URLs with routing across Serper, Brave, Tavily, Querit, Linkup, Exa, Firecrawl, You.com, SearXNG, SerpBase, and Keenable. Returns ranked sources and page text; supports freshness filters and research across providers.
